body:
Part of the **Veles OTP external devices** RFC execution plan (OTP-07).

MV3 service-worker launcher plus responsive connector tab owning the Native Messaging port, compatibility handshake and API negotiation, extension-owned search/selection UI, automatic reconnect via non-authoritative platform hints, request correlation, per-phone handle routing and queues, whole-record `send`/`sent`/`message` handling, closure cleanup, and typed missing/incompatible-host and BLE errors.

**Full task specification:** see section `### OTP-07` in the RFC: docs/rfcs/2026-08-21-otp-external-devices.md (PR #79) — https://github.com/raidenyn/veles-android/pull/79

The RFC body contains the authoritative **Outcome / Scope / Exclusions / Acceptance criteria / Verification evidence** for this task.

## OTP-23 carried-forward verification obligations


Tracking amendment from the post-grant review of #86 / PR #123 (baseline `cab043885ffe1991a6f3037c69a768ed6acbcd00`). These checklists assign future implementation/retest ownership; they do **not** mark a test PASS, waive a requirement, change dependencies, or authorize OTP-24. The current OTP-23 decision remains NO-GO until an explicit owner-approved gate amendment or satisfaction of its criteria. Only new-account W-01/M-01/M-02 are waived as nonblocking NOT RUN. Preserve earlier failed evidence and stable signing identities.

### Connector lifecycle and permission UX acceptance
- [ ] Exercise the real connector-to-host path for port disconnect, tab removal, browser closure and pending-request cancellation while two phones are linked. Link host-side W-07/W-08 evidence from #87; maintain generation/handle isolation after reconnect.
- [ ] Render and test actionable, platform-correct errors for access denied, radio off, missing adapter and missing/incompatible host. Recovery must work without extension reinstall or loss of installation/trust state.
- [ ] Reproduce the approved macOS Settings guidance from actual observations (#86 M-04); do not invent prompt ownership or treat a Settings toggle as observation of the original permission prompt.
Background/freeze/discard behavior is primarily owned by #90; combined acceptance by #94.
title: OTP-07: Build the Chrome native-bridge connector and launcher
